mapper.sql: select tbomdetail.id, tbomdetail.bom_id, tbomdetail.material_id, tbomdetail.count, tbomdetail.create_by, tbomdetail.create_time, tbomdetail.update_by, tbomdetail.update_time, tbomdetail.dept_id, tbomdetail.dept_name, tbomdetail.del_flag from t_bom_detail tbomdetail
mapper.delete: update t_bom_detail set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

mapper.select: select t1.id, t1.code, t1.name, t1.specifications, t1.batch_flag, t1.batch_attr_id, t1.base_unit_id, t1.same_material_flag, t1.same_batch_flag, t1.inspection_method, t1.expiration_date, t1.expiration_flag, t1.remark, t1.del_flag, t1.net_weight, t1.rough_weight, t2.name as unitName, t3.name as categoryName, t4.name as batch_attrName, t5.name as contactsUnitName, tbomdetail.count as predictCount from t_bom_detail tbomdetail left join t_material t1 on tbomdetail.material_id = t1.id left join t_unit t2 on t1.unit_id = t2.id left join t_category t3 on t1.category_id = t3.id left join t_batch_attr t4 on t1.batch_attr_id = t4.id left join t_contacts_unit t5 on t1.contacts_unit_id = t5.id where tbomdetail.del_flag = '0' and t1.del_flag = '0' and tbomdetail.bom_id = #{bomId} order by tbomdetail.create_time desc
